name: Tanarukk
sourceDistinctions: Races of Faerûn provides the detailed player traits. Underdark confirms 5 racial Hit Dice, LA +3, favored class Barbarian, and ECL 8.

Use the player version of Control Flame. It is spell-like, once daily, and caster level 5. The 2001 monster uses a supernatural ability twice daily; the 2004 monster conversion does not explicitly revise that line.
Spell resistance adds class levels to the base 14. Racial Hit Dice and level adjustment do not increase the total.
The 2004 monster conversion confirms the Native subtype, fire resistance 10, and revised spell resistance. The player-specific skill list comes from Races of Faerûn.
Both NPCs use the Northdark region and the 3.5 campaign rule that player characters know Common. The collected archive and FAQ give no direct correction to the Tanarukk player traits.
portraitForm: Khar Ashridge, an original Tanarukk with a battleaxe and no armor
